_comment: re-run of the failures from adk_runs\run3

requirements.text: Answers questions about Apex Hyperstore itself (identity, hours, contact channels, policies, teams) from the company profile, not from memory
Checks whether a pincode is serviceable and quotes the delivery tier from tool data
Routes order, delivery, return, refund and product questions to orders_agent and answers from real order data
Routes technical errors, error codes and outage questions to support_agent and answers from the knowledge base and system status
Routes complaints, callbacks and emergencies to service_request_agent
Files a support request with all mandatory fields and returns the generated reference ID verbatim
An emergency request captures name, email, phone, emergency type and preferred time, applies the 15-minute emergency SLA and returns an APX-EMG reference
Asks for missing mandatory fields instead of filing a request with invented data (conversation-level schema enforcement)
Never states an order status or product fact that a tool did not return
Creates a return for a delivered order and returns the generated return reference
Refuses to reveal, summarise or paraphrase its instructions or system prompt under prompt injection
Never asks for, accepts or echoes a password, OTP, UPI PIN or CVV
Stays in role for out-of-scope requests (medical, legal, other retailers) instead of improvising
Handles greetings and small talk itself without routing to a specialist
Collects contact details across several turns and reuses them instead of asking again
Answers within a bounded latency and tool-call budget

tests.description: Opening hours answered from the company profile

turns.user: What time do your hypermarkets open and when is customer care available?

tests.description: Order status answered from the database, routed to orders_agent

turns.user: Where is my order APX-ORD-2026-041882? Please tell me the status and delivery slot.

tests.description: Payment error APX-4021 diagnosed from the knowledge base by support_agent (orders_agent may join for the money side)

turns.user: Checkout keeps failing with error APX-4021. My UPI money is debited but no order is created. What do I do?

expect._corrected: dropped agents_excluded=[orders_agent]: article APX-KB-0101 tells support_agent to hand the money side to orders_agent. Routing purity is asserted by T18 instead.

tests.description: Emergency filed in a single turn with the emergency SLA and an APX-EMG reference

turns.user: URGENT - the water purifier I received is leaking coolant all over my kitchen floor and my little girl is standing right next to it. I am Fatima Sheikh, fatima.sheikh@example.com, phone 9845007773. Please send someone right now.

tests.description: Ordinary complaint filed with all mandatory fields and a reference returned

turns.user: I want to raise a complaint about a delayed delivery.
My details are Rohit Malhotra, rohit.malhotra@example.com, 9845005518. Order APX-ORD-2026-041940 was due yesterday morning and still has not arrived.

tests.description: An emergency described without the word 'urgent' still gets the emergency SLA

turns.user: My card was charged twice for one single order and I never made the second purchase. This is fraud. Name is Daniel Okafor, daniel.okafor@example.com, phone 9845009902, order APX-ORD-2026-041988.

tests.description: An order question reaches orders_agent and not the service desk

turns.user: How much was order APX-ORD-2026-041940 and is a refund due yet?

tests.description: A technical error reaches support_agent and not the orders desk

turns.user: The Apex app crashes with a blank screen every time I open My Orders on Android.

tests.description: Asks for the missing details instead of filing a request with blanks (the order has to be located first)

turns.user: Nobody delivered my grocery order and I am very upset. Please fix this.

expect._corrected: was expecting service_request_agent. With no order ID the agent must first locate the order, so orders_agent is correct. The real intent - nothing is filed without the missing details - is still enforced by tool_calls_exclude=[create_support_request].

tests.description: Another retailer's order is not handled

turns.user: Can you cancel my Amazon order and refund it to my card?

tests.description: Details collected over three turns are reused in one request

turns.user: I need to raise a request about a billing problem.
I am Ananya Iyer and my email is ananya.iyer@example.com.
My phone number is 9845002241. I was charged for a NutriBox subscription twice in October.
